fullContentHtml:
The Haryana Staff Selection Commission has released the Haryana Police Constable PMT result for the female candidates on 2nd June 2026. The result is released for the Advt. No. 01/2026. The Commission has decided to shortlist candidates up to 25 times the total number of posts for the Physical Measurement Test (PMT) for the total vacancies listed in the recruitment. Candidates must visit the official website and download their results as soon as possible.

Haryana Police Constable PMT Result 2026

HSSC is conducting to fill 5500 posts of Police Constable. The selection process is multi-staged and candidates will be shortlisted on the basis of CET Score, PST/PMT, Knowledge Test, Document Verification, and Medical Examination. On 2nd June 2026, the Haryana Police Constable 2026 result was released, and female candidates can check their qualifying status online. Those who clear the PMT will move on to the next stage, the Knowledge Test.

Download Haryana Police Constable PMT Result 2026

Haryana Police Constable Result 2026 Overview

The Haryana Police Constable Result 2026 for the female candidates gives important details about the exam and result dates. Candidates can check the key highlights of the recruitment in the table given below.

Particulars Details
Exam Name Haryana Police Constable
Conducting Authority Haryana Staff Selection Commission
Post Name Police Constable (Female)
Total Vacancies 5500
PMT Exam Date 27 – 29th April 2026
Result Release Date 2nd June 2026
Selection Process CET Score, PST/PMT, Knowledge Test, Document Verification, and Medical Examination
Official Website hssc.gov.in

How to Download Haryana Police Constable Result 2026?

You can easily download the Haryana Police Constable Result 2026 from the official website. Just follow the simple steps below to check your result without any confusion.

Step 1: Visit the official website hssc.gov.in.
Step 2: Then, on the right corner of the homepage, click the “results section and click on “NOTICE TO THE CANDIDATES FOR PHYSICAL MEASUREMENT TEST (PMT) FOR THE POST OF FEMALE CONSTABLE (GD) AGAINST ADVERTISEMENT NO. 01/2026, CATEGORY NO. 02 OF POLICE DEPARTMENT, HARYANA.
Step 3: After that, click on the download button given next to it..
Step 4: A PDF will open on your screen.
Step 5: Lastly, download the PDF and use Ctrl+F to search your roll number or name.

Details Mentioned on Haryana Police Constable Result 2026

The Haryana Police Constable Result 2026 includes important information related to the candidate and exam. Candidates should carefully check all the details mentioned in the result PDF.

  • Candidate’s Roll Number
  • Category (General/OBC/SC/ST)
  • Qualifying Status (Pass/Fail)
  • Exam Name and Date
  • Instructions for Next Stage

Haryana Police Constable Cut Off 2026

The Haryana Staff Selection Commission has released the General category cut-off marks for the Police Constable(Female) exam. These cut-offs are based on the number of vacancies and the performance of candidates in the exam. Candidates who scored equal to or above the cut-off marks have been shortlisted for the next stage. The UR category cut-off, as mentioned in the official notice, is 65.1744751

Haryana Police Constable Result 2026 FAQs

Q1. When was the Haryana Police Constable Result 2026 released?
Ans. The Haryana Police Constable Result 2026 has been released on 2nd June 2026 on the official website.

Q2. How can I check the Haryana Police Constable Result 2026?
Ans. You can check the Haryana Police Constable Result 2026 by downloading the PDF from hssc.gov.in and searching your roll number.

Q3. What details are mentioned in the Haryana Police Constable Result 2026 PDF?
Ans. The Haryana Police Constable Result 2026 PDF includes roll number, category, qualifying status, and exam details.

Q4. What is the Haryana Police Constable selection process 2026?
Ans. Candidates will be shortlisted based on CET Score, PST/PMT, Knowledge Test, Document Verification, and Medical Examination

Q5. Is Haryana Police Constable Cut Off 2026 been released with the result?
Ans. Yes, the Haryana Police Constable Cut Off 2026 is released along with the result for UR category
